name: settlement
description: Multi-paradigm settlement layout planner (聚落布局): produces a SCENE PLAN (JSON, not blocks) — building lots + road/path network + optional center node (plaza/altar). Four layout modes: grid (orthogonal roads, urban/classical), radial (concentric plaza rings + spoke lots, medieval city), organic (jittered winding roads, countryside), park (tiered path rings + planted trees/flowers + central altar). LLM chooses the layout mode + which cards fill the lots; the planner places them and emits a savable scene. Deterministic from seed. Consumed by scene_load.py.
when_to_use: 生成建筑群/村庄/公园的空间计划 (而非单栋); 多风格卡按布局范式组合。origin = 聚落西北角/中心, y = 地面层。先定路网与地块, 再分配建筑卡。mode 选 grid/radial/organic/park。产出 scene 可保存复现 (见 调研/scene-format.md)。

scene_id.notes: 场景名, 用于保存/归档

origin.notes: 聚落西北角格(grid/organic)或中心(radial/park); y = 地面层

mode.notes: 布局范式: 正交/辐射/有机/公园

lots.notes: 每地块建筑卡+朝向; 空则自动

default_card.notes: 未指定地块的默认建筑卡

centerpiece.notes: 中心节点: 无/广场/大祭坛

park_building.notes: park 外环建筑卡(如 chinese_palace); 中环保持树/花

seed.notes: 确定性种子; 同 seed 同布局

pitfalls: scene 是计划不是方块 — 别当 set_blocks 用, 要方块走 scene_load.py
地块尺寸(cell)必须能放下建筑 — 过小建筑越界, 参照卡内 typical_footprint
风格卡无生成器 — scene_load 会生成占位建筑, 真实建筑由 LLM 按卡替换(pending)
要改布局重跑 settlement 改参数, 别手改 scene — 保持确定性
example: python patterns/settlement.py --params '{"rows":3,"cols":3,"cell":8,"mode":"grid","centerpiece":"altar"}' --out town.json && python patterns/settlement.py --params '{"mode":"park","size":20}' --out park.json
